title: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a strong advocate of intersectional thinking focused on software products that are intuitive, organized, self-sustaining, and useful, and on teams that recognize and empower individuals to be their best selves and do their best work.
I studied Brain and Cognitive Sciences at MIT (with a minor in Architecture) and have worked as a product manager, UI/UX lead, software developer, and UX researcher.
